summary: The Houthi military launched dozens of ballistic missiles and drones at Saudi energy facilities and air force bases in southwest Saudi Arabia in response to 121 Saudi airstrikes on Yemen, marking a major regional escalation. Simultaneously, the IRGC Navy claims to have seized a US unmanned underwater vehicle at the entrance to the Strait of Hormuz, while Iran warned the US it could target American oil and gas interests in the Persian Gulf. Twelve European countries plus Canada announced trade bans on Israeli settlements, and the IDF anticipates combat strikes across the Lebanon front.
key_points: Houthi forces launched dozens of ballistic missiles and drones at Saudi energy facilities and air force bases in southwest Saudi Arabia in response to 121 Saudi airstrikes on Yemen, vowing further large-scale attacks (Source: @New_security8200/203687).
IRGC Navy claims seizure of a US unmanned underwater vehicle at the entrance to the Strait of Hormuz, with images promised within hours; US has not commented (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6928).
Iran warned the US that any new attack on Iranian assets could result in targeting American oil and gas interests in the Persian Gulf (Source: @kianmeli1/91639).

Twelve European countries and Canada announced sanctions or trade restrictions on products from Israeli settlements in the West Bank, citing unprecedented settler violence and expansion (Source: @SharghDaily/182587).
IDF anticipates a series of combat strikes on the Lebanon front with explosions expected in western Galilee, Hula Valley, Ramim Ridge, and possibly northern Golan (Source: @New_security8200/203683).
A Basij resistance zone commander was killed in a terrorist attack in Rasht, Sistan-Baluchestan province (Source: @VahidOnline/78274).
Massive fires reported at Abha fuel storage facility and Jizan refinery, both Aramco-owned, in Saudi Arabia (Source: @naya_foriraq/89677).
South Korea dispatched a team to assess the security situation at the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80541).

sections.executive_summary: The Houthi military launched dozens of ballistic missiles and drones at Saudi energy facilities and air force bases in southwest Saudi Arabia in response to 121 Saudi airstrikes on Yemen, marking a major regional escalation. Simultaneously, the IRGC Navy claims to have seized a US unmanned underwater vehicle at the entrance to the Strait of Hormuz, while Iran warned the US it could target American oil and gas interests in the Persian Gulf. Twelve European countries plus Canada announced trade bans on Israeli settlements, and the IDF anticipates combat strikes across the Lebanon front.
iran: A Basij resistance zone commander, Abdul Raouf Eshaqi, was killed in a terrorist attack in Rasht, Sistan-Baluchestan province on Tuesday 17 Shahrivar (Source: @VahidOnline/78274).
Heavy deployment of IRGC and Basij forces reported in Isfahan province, with petrol prices expected to jump by 2030Z (Source: @shin_persian/9552).
Iran warned the US on Monday that any new attack on Iranian assets could result in targeting American oil and gas interests in the Persian Gulf (Source: @kianmeli1/91639).
IRGC Navy claims to have seized a US unmanned underwater vehicle at the entrance to the Strait of Hormuz, with images of the vessel to be released within hours (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6928).
Resurfaced video shows IRGC former commander Hossein Salami speaking about the force's first successful test of an antiaircraft missile (Source: @presstv/205955).
Reports of launches from Iran toward the Strait of Hormuz have been documented (Source: @pkpoi/143882).
Israel is tracking unusual military movements and general deployment within Iran (Source: @lelotsenzura/94330).
israel: IDF anticipates a series of combat strikes on the Lebanon front, with explosions expected in western Galilee, Hula Valley, Ramim Ridge, and possibly northern Golan (Source: @New_security8200/203683).

IDF Chief of Staff stated at a graduation ceremony that the multi-year 'Hosen' plan emphasizes the naval domain, with INS Dolphin submarine currently en route to port as the sixth Israeli submarine (Source: @idf_telegram/25091).
US Central Command forces towed two vessels as part of the blockade against Iran (Source: @New_security8200/203685).

At the Kiryat Gat headquarters, military officials await a political decision on expelling representatives from countries that imposed a boycott on settlements, including Britain and France (Source: @New_security8200/203695).
Netanyahu announced Labor party candidates for the Knesset list, including a survivor of the October 7 attack and a former MK (Source: @yediotnews25/134816).
MK Avigdor Lieberman received severe threats including 'the butcher is on his way to you' and 'Nazi pig, may your name be erased' (Source: @yediotnews25/134811).

A joint statement by Iceland, Ireland, UK, Denmark, Norway, Spain, Poland, Portugal, Finland, France, Canada, and Sweden confirms intention to impose sanctions on trade with settlements (Source: @amitsegal/64758).
gaza_west_bank: Hamas spokesperson condemned Israeli escalation of home demolition operations in Gaza, particularly near displacement camps, calling it confirmation of continued 'war of genocide' (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/389790).

12 European countries including Britain, Canada, and France announced trade restrictions on Israeli settlement products in the West Bank in response to increased settler violence against Palestinian villages (Source: @mamlekate/104388).
Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov stated that Israel's security must be guaranteed through agreements, not military force (Source: @asafroz/53207).

West Bank settler population has doubled since the Oslo Accords, with more settlements built under the current government than in the previous 20 years, displacing Palestinian families and destroying homes (Source: @asafroz/53215).

12 European countries and Canada announced they will ban or limit trade with Israeli settlements, with foreign ministers of Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Ireland, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Spain, and Sweden joining a joint statement (Source: @mamlekate/104388).
lebanon: IDF anticipates combat strikes on the Lebanon front with explosions expected in western Galilee, Hula Valley, Ramim Ridge, and possibly northern Golan (Source: @New_security8200/203683).
Lebanese military map shows red zones indicating active conflict areas including the western Bekaa (Source: @redlinkleb/41588).
IDF Team 100 of 'Lebnaya Bakra' has been operating for a year combining sniper ambushes and drone detection capabilities (Source: @New_security8200/203696).
syria_iraq: Ansar Allah forces cut the road between Taiz and Mukalla after seizing the strategic Mafraq intersection in Taiz province; Saudi airstrikes are ongoing in the area (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/389792).
Yemeni Armed Forces conducted several airstrikes on IRGC-backed Houthi positions and gatherings on the Hamir front, Maqbanah, and western Taiz, Yemen (Source: @shin_persian/9559).

sections.threat_assessment: The convergence of Houthi strikes on Saudi energy infrastructure, IRGC seizure of a US underwater vehicle at the Strait of Hormuz, and Iran's explicit warning about targeting US oil and gas interests creates a high-risk scenario for regional energy security and potential direct US-Iran confrontation. The IDF's anticipation of multi-front combat strikes in Lebanon suggests imminent escalation with Hezbollah, while the killing of a Basij commander in Sistan-Baluchestan indicates ongoing internal security threats within Iran. South Korea's dispatch of an assessment team to the Strait of Hormuz signals international concern over potential disruption of global energy transit routes.
sections.regional_response: Twelve European countries plus Canada have coordinated sanctions against Israeli settlements, reflecting growing international pressure on Israel over West Bank expansion and settler violence. Russia's Foreign Minister Lavrov has called for diplomatic solutions to the Gaza conflict rather than military force. The UAE reportedly warned Netanyahu before October 7 about an impending Hamas attack, though the UAE office denies the report. Saudi Arabia faces a dual threat from Houthi attacks on its energy infrastructure and the broader regional destabilization affecting Aramco facilities at Abha and Jizan.
sections.intelligence_notes: Israel is actively tracking unusual military movements and general deployment within Iran, suggesting anticipation of further Iranian action. The IDF's 'Hosen' multi-year plan emphasizes naval superiority, with the INS Dolphin submarine entering port as the sixth Israeli submarine, indicating a strategic shift toward maritime dominance. US Central Command has towed two vessels as part of the blockade against Iran, while IRGC-affiliated media claims destruction of a US submarine — an unverified claim that should be treated with caution. The convergence of Houthi attacks on Saudi energy, IRGC naval activity at Hormuz, and anticipated Lebanon front strikes suggests a coordinated multi-front escalation cycle.
